title: 🐛 Fix line splitting in `format_sse_event` to comply with SSE spec
decision: Add _split_sse_lines helper that normalizes CRLF and lone CR to LF then splits on LF for data and comment branches
why: splitlines drops trailing empty strings and treats extra characters as line breaks while SSE only recognizes three terminators
